worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.summary: Latch roots onto a foe at close range: restore health scaled by how much stronger its Attack is than yours and drop its Attack by one stage. It saps strength, not life; no damage.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.descriptio: The roots reach a foe within %1$s blocks, which is also the real range.
Restores about %1$s of your maximum health, scaled by the target's Attack against your own; a stronger foe gives more.
The target loses %1$s Attack stage(s); the weakened opening lasts %2$s s.
It draws about %1$s strands of strength; higher Sp. Atk pulls harder.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.deep.on: Deep draw: x1.35 healing and x1.2 opening, at +2 wind-up ticks, a shorter reach (x0.9) and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.deep.off: Light draw: longer reach, faster wind-up and cooldown, with slightly less healing and a shorter opening.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.growth.0: From level %1$s the strands rise to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.growth.1: From level %1$s the drain share rises to %2$s, the Attack loss to %3$s and the opening to %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.use.0: Take a big mouthful of health from a strong foe when low
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.use.1: Pin a physical attacker's Attack on the way through
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.use.2: Shave a layer of strength off a physical threat first
worldcombat.skill.strengthsap.preference: On: x1.35 healing and x1.2 opening, at +2 wind-up ticks, a shorter reach (x0.9) and x1.15 cooldown, for one big gulp. Off: a lighter draw with longer reach, faster wind-up and cooldown.
Only reach out when a threat is this close; larger goes further to latch on.
Below this health ratio the user prefers strength sap as sustain; higher spends it sooner.
On: also leave a hold position to latch on.
